name: jjc-claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills and hooks shared across projects and with contributors.

plugins.name: intent-layer
plugins.description: Doctrine and commit-time reminders for CLAUDE.md intent-layer nodes — how to author, compress, and prune them, plus a hook that speaks when code changes without its node or a session shows a recurring pitfall.

plugins.name: ruff-gate
plugins.description: A ruff gate that travels between repos — lints the Python file it just wrote, then holds the turn open until everything the turn touched is clean. Silent in any repo without a ruff config, so it costs nothing where it isn't wanted.
